itemDisplayName: Scale Test: Deploy 5000 VMs with Premium V2 SSD Data Disks
description: Deploys 5000 Ubuntu 22.04 LTS VMs across availability zones using parallel batch ARM deployments. Each VM has 1 OS disk and 2 Premium V2 SSD (1 GiB) data disks. Includes orchestration script for automated deployment and cleanup.
summary: Deploy 5000 VMs with Premium V2 SSD data disks using parallel ARM template batches
